name: E2E Scaffolding - only a Restricted subgroup's creator may open it
description:
#4522. Opening a Restricted subgroup is its creator's decision alone - not an admin promoted inside it. The creator is fixed at the subgroup's birth and recorded from its GroupCreated, which every namespace member reads, so a member OUTSIDE the subgroup verifies an opening flip without the subgroup's sealed history: it applies the flip as it arrives, instead of parking it until some key holder serves it the subgroup's key.
Topology:
  * node-1 - the namespace owner, creates the subgroup.
  * node-2 - made an Admin of the subgroup, but not its creator.
  * node-3 - a namespace member outside the subgroup, offline through the
    flip.

Pinned:
  * node-2's opening flip is refused (an admin is not the creator);
  * node-1's is accepted, and node-3 - back online - reads the subgroup Open
    without a single backfill apply failing on the way.

steps.name: Node-1 names the subgroup (an op sealed under its key)
Node-1 makes node-2 an Admin of the subgroup
Let node-2 receive the subgroup key
Let node-3 apply what it pulled
Assert node-3 reads the subgroup Open
